system.description: A brazier sits at the top of a long wooden staff. Damage Rating: 4 Critical Rating: 4 Group: Staff Qualities: Attuned 2, Defensive, Magic Encumbrance: 4 The staff is attuned to the Wind of Agshy. Bright Wizards may add {Df} to Channelling and Spellcraft checks. Once per session, a Bright Order wizard wielding a flaming staff may remove a number of recharge tokens from his currently recharging Bright Order spells equal to his character rank.
